therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prolactin secretion suppression and tumor volume reduction
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Remission at 3, 6 and 12 months after treatment

dose_info.dose: 3.5 mg/week (high dose arm); up to 2 mg/week (conventional arm)
dose_info.schedule: once daily at target dose (high arm); adjusted per visit (conventional arm)
dose_info.dose_modifications: High arm: dose escalation by 0.5 mg/week over 7 weeks to 3.5 mg/week, then 1-month de-escalation reducing by 1 mg/week until discontinuation. Conventional arm: dose adjusted to achieve normoPRL, maximum 2 mg/week, withdrawn after 2 years.

context.duration: 2 years of treatment plus follow-up to December 2029

results_by_chain.biology_description: prolactin secretion suppression and tumor volume reduction
results_by_chain.population_description: Adults with microprolactinoma receiving high-dose cabergoline (3.5 mg/week)

results_by_chain.biology_description: prolactin secretion suppression and tumor volume reduction
results_by_chain.population_description: Adults with microprolactinoma receiving standard-dose cabergoline (up to 2 mg/week)
